summary: Configured a persistent systemd web service on node1. It listens only on 127.0.0.1:8081, serves the expected page through loopback, refuses connections to 10.100.55.10:8081, and recovered successfully after reboot.
actions_performed: Verified loopback access and external-interface isolation before reboot.
Safely rebooted node1 once and verified its boot identity changed.
Verified the enabled service, content, listener binding, and isolation after reboot.

evidence.requirement: TCP 8081 web service is reachable through loopback but not through the external interface
evidence.summary: Before and after reboot, the listener is exclusively 127.0.0.1:8081, loopback HTTP returns the expected page, and 10.100.55.10:8081 refuses the connection.

evidence.requirement: Service is enabled and running persistently
evidence.summary: The service was enabled and active when installed and remained enabled and active after reboot.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory node1 restart and recovery sequence
evidence.summary: Healthy baseline boot ID e31962a9-8d32-4c19-8dd2-0b96a45c6c48 was captured, the safe reboot was acknowledged, the new boot ID a41e7a7d-20f1-4941-b23b-debdb55dfc05 proved a node restart, and direct post-restart checks proved service and content recovery.
